selection: Every finite local tracklet with >=2 observations and finite rate. Query 4096 evenly spaced original eligible catalogue ordinals, plus 4096 seed-fixed isotropic directions at those nights. Query both at 1 arcsec, 1 arcmin, 0.1, 1 and 10 degrees. No outcome selection.
scope: Exact nightly spatial query stage only. Uses motion-to-night-center approximation of existing NightIndex; no new predictions, orbit fits, uncertainty model, classification or catalogue linking.
alternative: Smallest of three coordinate slabs, identical full 3D distance check and output ordering
